_warning: Feature definitions are IMMUTABLE after planning approval. Only passes, status, and subtasks[].status may be modified after approval.

features.name: PWA Installable Manifest
features.description: Make soletrade installable as a PWA by generating the required icon set, extending the brand-driven web app manifest, and wiring root metadata.
acceptanceCriteria: public/icons/ contains 192×192, 512×512, maskable 512, apple-touch-icon 180, and favicon PNGs
src/app/manifest.ts includes icons, scope, orientation, lang, categories, shortcuts, and prefer_related_applications
src/app/layout.tsx emits apple-touch-icon and favicon links via metadata.icons
src/app/manifest.test.ts passes with icon size and theme_color assertions
Lighthouse PWA audit shows 100/100 installable

subtasks.name: Generate and commit PWA icon set

features.name: Mobile Touch Targets
features.description: Increase the minimum hit area of buttons, inputs, icon-only triggers, selects, and assistant controls on narrow viewports while preserving desktop layouts.
acceptanceCriteria: Top 15 interactive controls have height ≥44 px at 390px viewport
Custom <select> elements use text-base below md to prevent iOS auto-zoom
Assistant suggested prompts, write-tool toggles, and send/stop buttons are ≥40 px tall on small screens
Desktop screenshots at 1280px show no visual regressions
Vitest suite remains green

features.name: Responsive Dialog Wrapper
features.description: Create and adopt a shared ResponsiveDialog component that renders a Sheet on small screens and a Dialog on desktop, then migrate the most-used confirmation flows.
acceptanceCriteria: ResponsiveDialog component exists and preserves Radix trigger/content/footer APIs
Customer-create dialog opens as bottom sheet at 390px and centered modal at 1280px
Quote accept, billing cancellation, billing manage actions, members/modules confirmations use ResponsiveDialog
No horizontal scroll is required to reach primary actions in any migrated dialog at 390px
Desktop modal behaviour unchanged

features.name: Mobile Dense Table Variants
features.description: Make the densest read-only tables usable on 390px-wide screens by converting invoice/quote line items, books summary, and tax lodged quarters into card rows or overflow-x-auto wrappers.
acceptanceCriteria: Invoice detail line items are readable without horizontal pinch-zoom at 390px
Quote detail line items are readable without horizontal pinch-zoom at 390px
Books summary is readable without horizontal pinch-zoom at 390px
Tax lodged-quarters table is readable without horizontal pinch-zoom at 390px
Totals alignment remains correct on desktop

features.name: Responsive Quote Signature Canvas
features.description: Resize the quote-accept signature canvas using a container ResizeObserver and devicePixelRatio scaling instead of a fixed 480×140 resolution.
acceptanceCriteria: Signature canvas fills available width on 390px and 1280px viewports
Canvas redraws correctly when viewport is resized
Signature image remains valid for quote acceptance after resize
No visual distortion on high-DPI displays

features.name: Playwright E2E Scaffold
features.description: Install and configure @playwright/test, create playwright.config.ts with desktop and mobile projects, add package scripts, and wire local Supabase seed reset as global setup.
acceptanceCriteria: pnpm test:e2e runs the health spec against the local dev server
playwright.config.ts includes Desktop Chrome, iPhone 12/13, Pixel 7, and iPad Mini projects
pnpm db:reset runs once as global setup before specs
Playwright does not break pnpm test:ci or Vitest tests
README.md documents how to run E2E tests

subtasks.name: Add package scripts and CI wiring

features.name: Playwright Auth Fixtures
features.description: Create storage-state fixtures for each seeded role (owner, admin, accountant, employee, readonly) and helpers for switching workspace and selecting seeded entities.
acceptanceCriteria: e2e/fixtures/auth.ts signs in each seeded role and saves storage state under e2e/.auth/
Each role fixture loads in <2s after initial storage-state generation
e2e/auth/roles.spec.ts verifies expected navigation visibility per role
Fixture utilities allow switching between WS1 and WS2
Auth rate-limiting is avoided by reusing storage state

features.name: Core E2E Smoke Flows
features.description: Implement seed-data-driven end-to-end specs covering login/dashboard, create-and-send invoice, accept quote, create books transaction, and invite member.
acceptanceCriteria: e2e/dashboard.spec.ts passes on desktop and iPhone
e2e/invoices/create-send.spec.ts passes on desktop
e2e/quotes/accept-convert.spec.ts passes on desktop using a fresh public token
e2e/books/create-transaction.spec.ts passes on desktop
e2e/settings/invite-member.spec.ts passes on desktop

features.name: Minimal Service Worker / Offline Fallback
features.description: Add a minimal network-first service worker registered from a client component, with a static /offline fallback, after PWA manifest installability is verified.
acceptanceCriteria: src/app/offline/page.tsx exists and renders without JavaScript
Service worker precaches /_next/static/*, /fonts/*, /icons/*
Service worker uses network-first for navigations and serves /offline on failure
/api/*, /i/*, /q/*, /invite/*, and Stripe scripts are excluded from caching
Registration works on desktop Chrome and mobile Safari

subtasks.name: Register service worker from root layout
